headline: Ivory Coast leads 1-0 at halftime in World Cup clash against Germany
summary: Ivory Coast takes an early lead in their Group E match, while Germany maintains an unchanged lineup from their opening game.
details: Ivory Coast holds a 1-0 lead over Germany at the halftime break of their World Cup Group E encounter on Saturday.
Germany entered the match with an unchanged starting eleven, featuring Kai Havertz leading the attack after his two goals against Curacao.
Ivory Coast made a strategic change to their lineup, adding Amad Diallo to the starting eleven after he scored the winning goal against Ecuador.
The German squad includes Manuel Neuer, Joshua Kimmich, and Jamal Musiala, while Ivory Coast is led by players like Franck Kessie and Ibrahim Sangare.
The match remains tense as Germany looks to find an equalizer in the second half to stay competitive in the group stage.
